in_marathi.name: Sintu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sintu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Sintu is the name of the goddess of wisdom, knowledge and learning. She is often depicted as holding a book or a lotus in her hands, symbolizing the importance of education and knowledge.
